high_level_description: The image depicts the TMB Bank office building in Bangkok from 2006. The building is prominently featured with a large mural painted on its facade. The mural includes two portraits of individuals, one on the left and one on the right. Both portraits appear to be of significant figures, possibly political or historical leaders, given their formal attire and the context of the mural's placement on a bank building. The TMB Bank logo is clearly visible at the top of the building, indicating the institution's branding.
